system_prompt_style.evidence_quote:
Project rules,
persistent memory, Skills, and long-conversation compaction help the Agent keep
context throughout complex work.
system_prompt_style.note: Prompt assembled from project rules, memory and Skills; no prompt file in evidence.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote:
DeepCode can read and search code, edit files, apply patches, run commands and
tests, and continue working from the results.
env_context_strategy.note: Paper's Paper2Code pipeline adds CodeRAG retrieval; default v2 agent navigates.

context_compaction.evidence_quote:
the free-form TUI, native file and shell
tools, headless execution, context compaction, and cross-directory resume
context_compaction.note: "long-conversation compaction"; also CodeMem summarization in paper Sec. 3.2.1.

observation_format.evidence_quote:
Tool calls, execution progress,
and file changes stay visible

edit_primitive.evidence_quote:
DeepCode can read and search code, edit files, apply patches, run commands and
tests
edit_primitive.note: "apply patches" -> unified_diff; edit primitive details not in evidence; paper mentions LSP-based line-level modifications.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote:
A real MCP probe
initializes the server and counts tools, resources, and prompts.
tool_schema_source.note: Built-in tool schema source not shown in evidence; MCP servers are disabled by default.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: Connect standard MCP servers from every interface.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote:
The Agent keeps analyzing, implementing, verifying, and fixing
around that Goal without requiring you to push every step manually.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: | `ThreadGoal` | What outcome is the agent still pursuing across Turns? |
planning_granularity.note: Durable Goal record with acceptance criteria; paper also has staged development plan blueprint.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote:
Complex work can be split across focused Agents—for example, separate Agents
for code investigation, test analysis, and implementation review.
multi_agent_topology.note: Default is one Agent runtime; delegation to parallel worktree agents is optional, orchestrator_workers when used. Paper's Paper2Code pipeline is a multi-agent pipeline.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote:
Parallel changes can run in isolated Git worktrees so Agents do not edit the
same working directory at once.
delegation_mechanism.note: Opt-in delegation; main Agent remains responsible.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: **Ask**: confirm sensitive operations before they run;
human_in_loop.note: Three selectable Session modes: Ask, Read only, Full access.

short_term_state.evidence_quote:
A Session stores more than chat text: it keeps tool calls, permission
decisions, Goals, model configuration, and verification records.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote:
project instructions can live in `AGENTS.md` or `DEEPCODE.md`, and
persistent notes remain with the workspace.

state_persistence.evidence_quote:
Long-running Goals
are resumable across CLI and Desktop, while guarded archival and deletion
preserve repository files and recover safely after interruption.

self_verification.evidence_quote:
It
selects evidence that fits the task, such as test results, build output, static
checks, diagnostics, file changes, Diffs, or generated Artifacts.
self_verification.note: Paper Sec. 3.3 adds Analysis Agent static analysis and sandbox execution; review Agents optional.

retry_policy.evidence_quote:
A failed verification is not presented as success. It becomes input to the
next repair.
retry_policy.note: No fixed iteration count: "a fixed number of agent iterations or retries" is not hardcoded.

rollback.evidence_quote: Parallel changes can run in isolated Git worktrees
rollback.note: No explicit undo/revert tool in the evidence; worktree isolation is the closest mechanism.

termination_condition.evidence_quote:
When a task is complete—or genuinely blocked—the result, reason,
and related evidence remain in the Session for review and reproduction.
termination_condition.note: No step/cost caps found; docs state a fixed number of agent iterations is not hardcoded. User /stop also available.

timeouts.evidence_quote:
share one generic
stdio/SSE/Streamable HTTP client runtime with bounded discovery, stable tool
identities, timeouts, cancellation, and session-owned cleanup.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote:
A Job Object backend gives the
sandbox real process-tree isolation where previously there was none.
execution_isolation.note: Local execution in the user's project directory with platform sandboxing; paper Phase 3 uses a sandbox for verification.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: Every project must be explicitly trusted before execution.
filesystem_access.note: Sensitive-path protection and project trust scope access to the trusted project.

network_policy.evidence_quote:
the shared `web_fetch` tool can
read the page without a search provider or an additional API key.

permission_model.note: Default Session mode is Ask (confirm sensitive operations); static per-tool allow/deny also available.

tracing.note: Canonical JSONL Session store plus SQLite projection.

replayability.evidence_quote:
Replay remains available after overflow, disconnection, or
restart.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote:
Extensive evaluations on the PaperBench benchmark demonstrate that DeepCode
achieves state-of-the-art performance
eval_hooks.note: No evaluation runner visible in the pinned repo evidence; PaperBench evaluation reported in the paper only.

guardrails.evidence_quote:
three-valued permissions, sensitive-path protection, platform sandboxing, and
normalized events made supervised local execution possible.
guardrails.note: Credentials kept out of Session history suggests output filtering but is not explicit.

target_domain.evidence_quote: DeepCode is an open-source Coding Agent for real software engineering.
target_domain.note: Paper2Code research reproduction; generic MCP runtime.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote:
DeepCode is not tied to one model provider. Connect OpenRouter, OpenAI,
Anthropic, DeepSeek, Gemini, an OpenAI-compatible gateway, Ollama, vLLM, or
another compatible endpoint with your own API Key.

primary_artifact.note: v2 general coding agent postdates the Paper2Code paper.

first_release_date.note: Basis: first release of the coded v2 line per README News; earlier 1.x releases exist.
